notes.title: New Release - Trainz 2010: Settle and Carlisle
notes.content:
Trainz 2010: Settle and Carlisle is now available on Steam.

We take you to one of the most famous and scenic British main lines at the time of the transition from steam to diesel power. With 10 different types of locomotives and dozens of rolling stock items at your disposal you decide what train to drive. Sessions featuring Anglo-Scottish expresses, local stopping trains, fast freights, heavy mineral, slow pickup goods or trip workings offer a rich variety of services for your enjoyment.
